detail.longDescription: If you’re looking for an analytics software that respects user privacy, was not coded with AI and despises it , works wonderfully, it’s free, open source and easily self-hostable I can’t recommend enough Goatcounter . Even if you don’t need it, go show some love, star the repo, donate to its author, sponsor him. Great human work. # Software # NoAI # FuckGenAI # FuckAI # Coding # Programming # OSS # FOSS
